name: FLUX 3 Image To Video
description: FLUX 3 image-to-video from one or more keyframe images, 5-20s with native audio, billed per second of generated video at 720p or 1080p. Draft mode is a cheaper 720p-only preview that can be re-rendered at full quality.

Flux3Keyframe.description:
One keyframe image, optionally anchored to a timeline position. A uniform
object shape (rather than BFL's string/list/pair union) so the request stays
machine-renderable; the resolver folds it back onto the provider wire.

at_s.description: Seconds into the clip this frame anchors at. Set it on every keyframe or on none.
at_s.title: At (seconds)

Flux3Keyframe.title: Flux3Keyframe

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

duration.description: Video length in whole seconds (5-20), or "auto" to let the model choose.
duration.title: Duration

draft.description: Generate a cheaper 720p draft preview instead of a full-quality render.
draft.title: Draft

keyframes.description: Keyframe images: one opening frame, several frames to interpolate through, or timestamped frames (set at_s on every entry).
keyframes.title: Keyframes
